title: VLNS Cross-System Capability and Attribute Index
scope_note: Evidence-preserving inventory. Described capability is not proof of executable runtime. System/repository identity mappings remain unresolved where stated.

index_contract.source_of_truth: This registry plus its evidence_refs; runtime connectivity must be measured independently.
index_contract.promotion_rule: No property is promoted from SPECIFIED/PROPOSED to IMPLEMENTED or VERIFIED without executable evidence and explicit authority.

systems.role: Sovereign control plane, canonical registry, governance, provenance, recovery, admission
Knowledge, discovery, adversarial analysis, repository intelligence, model-independent engineering fabric
Governed execution, state transitions, runtime, generation, verification, replay
Discovery network, architecture search, research, synthesis

connections.contract: Discovery output becomes a sourced proposal; canonical admission remains with VAIXLNS.
Model/semantic activation envelope carries identity, provider/model version, role, capability profile, context hash, tool and permission profiles, constraints, provenance and activation ID.
Research and architecture candidates may be exchanged as versioned, provenance-bearing artifacts; a direct live API contract has not been established in inspected sources.
Execution emits events, observations, test outcomes and evidence references; VAIXLNS governs reconciliation and admission.

properties.name: System/repository identity
properties.value: VLNS ↔ NAXLNS is a candidate mapping only; not proven by name similarity.

properties.name: Knowledge/discovery role
properties.value: Repository intelligence, adversarial analysis, discovery, engineering analysis and proposals.

properties.name: Authority ceiling
properties.value: VLNS/NAXLNS proposals cannot self-promote to canonical or production status; VAIXLNS retains admission authority.

properties.name: Activation envelope
properties.value: model_id, provider, model_version, role, capability_profile, context_hash, tool_profile, permission_profile, constraints, provenance, activation_id.

properties.name: Default permissions
properties.value: Deny by default; activation cannot grant canonical writes, unrestricted network, external actions, governance override or automatic adoption.

properties.name: Connection status
properties.value: Last recorded probe: UNREACHABLE_FROM_CURRENT_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT; authenticated_connection=false. This is historical status, not a fresh live probe.

properties.name: Inspected candidate repository tree
properties.value: Nine tree entries at inspected revision: README, repository contract, three federation/integration documents, and one conformance workflow hierarchy; no executable Python/package entrypoint was established in that tree snapshot.

properties.name: Runtime metrics/logs/traces
properties.value: Federation deployment manifest requires metrics and logs and recommends traces; deployed pipeline was not verified.

properties.name: Promotion rule
properties.value: An artifact or README does not prove running implementation; require source revision, dependencies, startup, health, tests, execution evidence, verification state and timestamp.

properties.name: Engineering dashboard reachability
properties.value: The console bridge currently binds loopback. Remote phone access requires an authenticated host/gateway or approved hosted front end; do not expose the unauthenticated local bridge directly.

gaps.issue: VLNS ↔ NAXLNS identity mapping is explicitly UNVERIFIED.
gaps.required_evidence: Canonical identity/lineage statement accepted by VAIXLNS plus source-owner evidence.
gaps.next_action: Resolve identity without renaming or merging repositories.

gaps.issue: Connection registry records the VLNS control endpoint as unreachable from the prior execution environment and unauthenticated.
gaps.required_evidence: Fresh authenticated health probe from the target network with endpoint revision and timestamp.
gaps.next_action: Configure endpoint and credentials in the target runtime secret store; rerun probe.

gaps.issue: The inspected NAXLNS tree is document/workflow-only in the observed snapshot; a runnable service entrypoint/dependency set was not established.
gaps.required_evidence: Entrypoint, dependency lock/manifest, reproducible start, health check and tests.
gaps.next_action: Inventory all branches/history, then implement only the missing runtime slice.

gaps.issue: Model/provider-neutral activation is specified but provider adapter conformance is not demonstrated.
gaps.required_evidence: Adapter contract tests for one local model runtime, then each additional provider.
gaps.next_action: Start with a local Ollama adapter behind the neutral activation envelope.

gaps.issue: Deployment requires metrics/logs; traces are recommended, but a deployed telemetry pipeline is not verified.
gaps.required_evidence: Probeable health endpoint, structured logs, metrics, trace correlation and durable evidence references.
gaps.next_action: Add health/readiness and trace/event correlation before production promotion.

gaps.issue: Historical master index records 0001–2750 are not all exposed item-by-item in current corpus.
gaps.required_evidence: Atomic row inventory with stable IDs, provenance and lossless source references.
gaps.next_action: Run index archaeology and produce coverage/missing-range report.

gaps.issue: Existing command console uses a loopback-only bridge; this protects local access but prevents direct access from a separate phone to a remote host.
gaps.required_evidence: Authenticated HTTPS gateway or hosted static UI with narrowly scoped authenticated API.
gaps.next_action: Keep loopback default; add remote access only behind identity and policy enforcement.

gaps.issue: Architectural edges are documented, but live authenticated VLNS↔VAIXLNS, VLNS↔VX and NEXNET↔VLNS links are not verified.
gaps.required_evidence: Per-edge contract test, authentication evidence, correlation ID, replayable request/response and failure-injection test.
gaps.next_action: Implement one connector at a time and gate it through sandbox and independent verification.
